newsitem.title: POLAND: Optimus extends surge on bond conversion.
newsitem.headline: Optimus extends surge on bond conversion.

text.p: Polish computer maker Optimus surged by nearly the daily 10 percent maximum to 105 zlotys in heavy trade on Monday, continuing a rise begun on Thursday when the firm said it had received orders to convert 159 of its convertible bonds.
The firm said the conversion would free reserves linked with the issue and raise January pre-tax profit by 1.3 million zlotys.

But traders on Monday said the stock's growth could now slow before rebounding, signalled by balanced trade after price fixing rather than Friday's post-price-fixing demand which was strong enough for investors to have their bids reduced.
"You can see there's a weakening -- the stock could even fall tomorrow but I think it has near-term potential to around 120 zlotys," one trader said.
